purpose: User-requested real replay of all seven roles after repair, followed by actual public browser verification.
entrySource: automation/task-export.json; role prompt files and common.md remain authoritative
executionRules: Read the same manifest, common prompt, role prompt, modules contract and watchlist config as the permanent role.
